triples.tail_surface: continuous monitoring of shaft system vibration
triples.evidence_text: Permanent means of continuous monitoring of shaft system vibration, or alternatively, a continuous oil-debris monitoring system to detect the passage of metallic particles in the bearing lubricating oil lines is to be provided at the machinery control station(s) in order to detect early sign of pod shaft bearing deterioration.
